 ORDER
Heard and perused the case diary.

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail in relation to FIR/Crime No.653/2023, registered at Police Station-Kanwan, District Dhar, for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC, 1860 and Sections 3/4 and 5(l)/6 of Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Applicant is in jail since 20.12.2023.
2. As per prosecution story, it is alleged that the applicant has abducted and committed rape upon prosecutrix.

3. It is contended by the learned counsel for the applicant that as per statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the applicant and the prosecutrix resided together as husband and wife for more than one year in Gujarat.

It seems that the relationship between the Dashrath vs State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25560191/
1 prosecutrix and applicant was consensual in nature.

entities.text: Dashrath vs State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case,
The age of the applicant is 20 years and he is in custody since 20.12.2023 i.e. nearly five months and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Hence, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
4 . Per contra, learned Panel Lawyer for the State has opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and custody period of the applicant, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this first bail application u/s. 439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant/accused be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
